label: L A M P L I G H T   S C R I P T U R E
end_line: The whole story of Daniel is waiting for you. The link is in the description. Subscribe, and tap the bell, for more Bible stories for sleep.
text: A golden image on a wide plain, and three friends who would not bow. The king threatened them with the furnace. This was their quiet answer. Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter. If it happens, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king. But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image which you have set up.
